verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages name a first-party Transaction Monitoring agent as part of Mesh agentic workflows. That agent auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates complex cases for human review, so the product itself provides an in-product agent that works transaction alerts. The evidence is limited to thin marketing mentions, and nothing shows the agent preparing review notes or narratives. Missing for 10: documented agent investigation steps for transaction alerts, evidence of generated review notes or case narratives, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
